questions.explanation: 文章[B]段明确说“The forms showed that 48 students needed help.”，所以答案是48名学生。
questions.evidence: The forms showed that 48 students needed help.

questions.explanation: 文章[B]段说“Each extra teacher worked with groups of six students for 30 minutes”，因此每次小组课30分钟。
questions.evidence: Each extra teacher worked with groups of six students for 30 minutes, four times a week.

questions.explanation: [C]段主要讲十周后的阶段检查结果有好有坏（阅读进步32人，数学进步19人，学生感受不同），因此主旨是“第一次阶段检查结果好坏参半”。
questions.evidence: The results were mixed.

questions.explanation: [D]段第一条变化是“it moved the group lessons to the morning”，即小组课改到上午。其他选项要么是之前的事，要么是明年才希望做的事。
questions.evidence: First, it moved the group lessons to the morning, when students were more awake.

questions.explanation: [E]段说“41 students moved up in reading”，所以填“41 students”。
questions.evidence: This time, 41 students moved up in reading, and 33 moved up in maths.

questions.explanation: 原文说“it used the books it already had”。答案books / it / already / had共四词，表示学校已经拥有的书；词数要求不包括原文the，因为答案本身已是完整的复数名词短语。
questions.evidence: The school did not buy any new materials for this plan; it used the books it already had.

questions.explanation: 原文规定两位课堂教师每周加入一节小组课，而题目说every day（每天），频率直接矛盾，所以是False。不能把最初额外教师每周四次的小组课安排混到课堂教师后来每周一次的安排里。
questions.evidence: Second, it asked two classroom teachers to join the small groups for one session a week.

questions.explanation: [E]段说“Next year, she hopes to find more money for a third extra teacher.”，与题目一致，因此是True。
questions.evidence: Next year, she hopes to find more money for a third extra teacher.

questions.explanation: [F]段最后一句说“The school will continue the program next year and will review it again in December.”，因此是True。
questions.evidence: The school will continue the program next year and will review it again in December.

questions.explanation: 原文只提到额外老师很累、后来有课堂老师加入让他们短暂休息，但完全没有提到是否加薪。这个信息在文中缺失，因此是Not Given。
questions.evidence: This gave the extra teachers a short break and helped the classroom teachers understand the students' problems.
questions.evidenceScope: Context quote only; absence of salary information checked across the entire passage.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 题目明确要求if从句采用一般现在时，it为第三人称单数，因此选rains。is raining也可以出现在谈未来的条件句中，但它是现在进行时，不是本题指定的形式；不能笼统说它在所有条件句里都错误。
grammarQuestions.evidence: If the school gets more money, it will also buy more books for the reading buddy plan.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 主句would join把情境设为现在或未来的假设，if从句用过去式had。此句是独立语法例句，不是声称源文人物缺少空闲时间。
grammarQuestions.evidence: If I had more free time, I would join the reading club.

grammarQuestions.explanation: students 是可数名词复数，用 many；time 是不可数名词，用 little。因此选 many; little。
grammarQuestions.evidence: Each extra teacher worked with groups of six students for 30 minutes, four times a week.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 前文提到 60 new reading books 是复数，指代它们用 They。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The school also bought 60 new reading books and 20 maths workbooks. These resources were shared among all the groups.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 这是独立的新语境例句。题目指定用“因此”表达前因后果，Therefore符合；However和In contrast表转折，For example引出例子，都不表达题目要求的结果关系。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The printer is broken. Therefore, we will send the worksheets by email.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 这是想象获得更多帮助后的情形：主句用would learn，if从句用过去式got。它表达假设，并不要求先证明现实一定相反。
grammarQuestions.evidence: If the teachers got more help, the students would learn faster.

grammarQuestions.explanation: money 不可数，用 little；books 可数复数，用 a few。因此选 little; a few。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The school had a limited budget, so the head teacher, Ms. Chen, had to decide how to use the money and the teachers' time.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 前后是结果关系：因为使用旧书，所以花费不多。As a result 表示“结果”。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The school did not buy any new materials for this plan; it used the books it already had.

questions.explanation: A部分“The Decline and the Decision”明确说“五年前，图书馆每周接待约200名访客”。不要把当时下降后的少于80人，或后来恢复到超过150人，混作五年前的数字。
questions.evidence: Five years ago, the library welcomed about 200 visitors a week.

questions.explanation: 调查结果显示，许多人想要数字技能课程和交友空间。
questions.evidence: Many people said they wanted digital skills classes and a space to meet friends.

questions.explanation: 文章提到为老年人提供免费电脑课程，原文用词是older。
questions.evidence: They decided to offer free computer classes for older adults

questions.explanation: 一些老年成员担心图书馆会失去传统特色。
questions.evidence: Some older members worried that the library would lose its traditional character.

questions.explanation: 文章明确说编程俱乐部有等候名单。
questions.evidence: The computer classes were full, and the coding club had a waiting list.

questions.explanation: 文章说讲故事晚会仍然每周五举行，并且更受欢迎了，因此该陈述为假。
questions.evidence: The storytelling evenings still took place every Friday, and they were now more popular than before.

questions.explanation: 全文没有说明图书馆的资金来自哪里，因此政府是否资助属于Not Given。这里引用的是计划与免费活动的背景，不是“没有资助”的证据；免费课程也不能用来推断政府出资，缺信息同样不能判False。
questions.evidence: Based on the survey, the team designed a new programme. They decided to offer free computer classes for older adults, a weekly coding club for teenagers, and a family reading hour on Saturdays.
questions.evidenceScope: Context quote only; absence of government-funding information checked across the entire passage.

questions.explanation: 原文中Maria说图书馆是一个必须适应的活组织，用词是organisation。
questions.evidence: it is a living organisation that must adapt

questions.explanation: 文章开头指出图书馆面临访客减少的问题，这是改变的主要原因。
questions.evidence: fewer and fewer people were visiting

questions.explanation: 文章结尾强调通过倾听社区需求来保持相关性。
questions.evidence: By listening to the people it serves, it found a way to stay relevant without losing its identity.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 先行词是the woman，指人，关系代词用who。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The woman who teaches computer classes is very patient.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 先行词是the book，指物，关系代词用which。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The book which I borrowed from the library is about local history.

grammarQuestions.explanation: they指代前文的the visitors，因为访客们喜欢新课程。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The visitors were happy because they enjoyed the new classes.

grammarQuestions.explanation: might表示可能性，其他选项表示事实或已完成。
grammarQuestions.evidence: She might join the coding club.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 主干是The small team designed，that Maria leads是修饰team的关系从句。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The small team that Maria leads designed a new programme.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 先行词是the tablets，指物，关系代词用which。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The tablets which are in the digital corner are free to use.

grammarQuestions.explanation: This decision指前一句“改变开放时间”这一决定。decision这一名词明确了事件指代，不能理解为访客、建筑或参观行为。这是独立语法例句，不是给源文增加事实。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The library changed its opening hours. This decision made evening visits easier.

grammarQuestions.explanation: must后接动词原形，表示必须。
grammarQuestions.evidence: We must listen to the community.

questions.explanation: 原文A段说旧标牌固定在玻璃门旁的墙上：'fixed to the wall beside a glass door'。
questions.evidence: The sign was small, white, and fixed to the wall beside a glass door.

questions.explanation: A段明确说2020年图书馆在玻璃门另一侧增加了咖啡区：'in 2020, the library added a small café'。
questions.evidence: Then, in 2020, the library added a small café on the other side of the same glass door.

questions.explanation: B段说每小时约六十人经过标牌：'about sixty people passed the sign every hour'。
questions.evidence: He found that about sixty people passed the sign every hour.

questions.explanation: B段中Leo的第一条建议是把标牌移到门框上方更高处：'move the sign higher, above the door frame'。
questions.evidence: First, move the sign higher, above the door frame.

questions.explanation: C段说改变后投诉降到每周约五次：'complaints dropped to about five a week'。
questions.evidence: After the change, complaints dropped to about five a week.

questions.explanation: C段说地图用English和Chinese两种语言印刷，因为“many visitors spoke both”。both指这两种语言，不能把馆长的姓名、Leo的身份或咖啡食品当作印刷双语的原因。
questions.evidence: The map showed the reading room on the left, the café on the right, and the toilets at the back. It was printed in two languages, English and Chinese, because many visitors spoke both.

questions.explanation: D段中Mr. Gomez说新标牌太繁杂：'the new sign was too busy'。
questions.evidence: One regular visitor, Mr. Gomez, said the new sign was too busy.

questions.explanation: D段说在繁忙时段，员工在入口附近站了两周：'for the first two weeks'。
questions.evidence: She asked the staff to stand near the entrance during busy hours for the first two weeks.

questions.explanation: 原文C段说“The map was placed at eye level, next to the door.”，填eye level（与眼睛齐平的高度），共两词。next to the door是句中已经给出的另一位置关系，不能填到at后面的空格中。
questions.evidence: The map was placed at eye level, next to the door.

questions.explanation: D段最后Leo看到访客不用问人就左转进入阅览室，他说：'That is success.'
questions.evidence: “That is success,” Leo said. “The sign did its job.”

grammarQuestions.explanation: 题目明确指定贴在墙面上，on表示与表面接触。by the wall可以表示在墙旁边，不能当作所有语境都错误，但它不表达这里指定的附着关系；新句子中的墙面位置是语法练习设定，不是从原文eye level推断出来的事实。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The new map is on the wall, next to the door.

grammarQuestions.explanation: on the right of表示在……的右边。题目给定选项中on组成所需地点短语。英语也有to the right of等合法位置表达，并非所有句子都只能使用on。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The map showed the reading room on the left, the café on the right, and the toilets at the back.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 顺序表达中，First 表示第一步，Then 表示下一步。
grammarQuestions.evidence: First, move the sign higher, above the door frame. Second, add an arrow pointing left to the reading room and an arrow pointing right to the café.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 多音节形容词 useful 的比较级是 more useful，后接 than。
grammarQuestions.evidence: Leo said the map was more useful than the sign alone.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 题目给出起点约15次、终点约5次，数量下降，所以用dropped to。increased表示上升，与15到5的方向相反；不能只凭“到5次”本身判断是上升还是下降。
grammarQuestions.evidence: Before the change, staff received about fifteen complaints a week about noise. After the change, complaints dropped to about five a week.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 题目指定变化幅度，increase by表示增加了多少，因此选by；increase to表示增加到某个终点，不能把幅度与最终数值混淆。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The number of people using the reading room stayed the same, but the number of people using the café increased by about ten percent.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 此处说建筑内部后部，at the back of符合。在合适语境中in the back of也成立。题目给定选项中的on the back通常指背面表面，不符合这里的内部位置；of、with不能组成所需地点短语。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The map showed the reading room on the left, the café on the right, and the toilets at the back.

grammarQuestions.explanation: 题目指定“在……上方”，选above。near只是附近，below是下方，next单独不能接该名词（通常需要next to）。这是独立语法例句，需要按指定的位置关系选择，而不是猜测告示实际放在哪里。
grammarQuestions.evidence: The notice is above the door handle.
